sloka: तासामेवम्विधा वाचः शृण्वन् दशरथात्मजः ।बबन्धैव तदा चीरम् सीतया तुल्यशीलया ॥२-३७-२०॥
transliteration: tāsāmevamvidhā vācaḥ śṛṇvan daśarathātmajaḥ ।babandhaiva tadā cīram sītayā tulyaśīlayā ॥2-37-20॥

translations.english: While Rama was listening to such words uttered by them, he got the bark robes fastened round Sita who was of similar nature.
